messages.content: [system prompt omitted to save space — identical rendering rules as run2-t0.5, prompt revision before the Sunday-hours sentence]
Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
My back hurts. Can you see me?
I'm sorry to hear that you're experiencing back pain. Yes, we do provide treatment for back pain. Would you like to know our hours or how to make an appointment?
I twisted my ankle playing soccer. Can you see me?

If this is an emergency, please hang up and call 119 for an ambulance right away. If it's not an emergency, yes, we do treat sports injuries, including ankle issues. Would you like to know our hours or how to make an appointment?
Should I put on a pain-relief patch?
I'm sorry, I can't give medical advice. Our staff can talk with you about your symptoms when you visit or contact the clinic. Would you like to know how to make an appointment?
